edges.why: Toledo is No. 8 of 138 against the run (28%). Buffalo ranks No. 124 in rush success rate (36%). This is not a lean. It is a mismatch, and a prominent one. Toledo erases the run. Buffalo gets pushed into passing downs, and that is where this defense makes its money.
